name: Iran
description: Follow Iran, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Iran and Kuwait report attacks on water and power infrastructure as strikes escalate
changes.summary: Critical water and power infrastructure sites have been damaged as the U.S. and Iran continue to trade strikes, while the parched Middle East reels from temperatures of 100 degrees and beyond.

changes.title: Iran says it is suspending commitments to interim deal with U.S. as they exchange attacks
changes.summary: The widening strikes threatened civilians and services to them, including desalination plants for drinking water, while the global economy again was on alert.

changes.title: U.S. military says 2 troops are dead and 1 is missing after Iran attacks a base in Jordan
changes.summary: Since the war began, 16 U.S. service members have now been killed and over 430 wounded.

changes.title: Why Jordan Is Becoming a New Focus in the U.S.-Iran War
changes.summary: Four Iranian attacks in five days have targeted U.S. troops in Jordan, U.S. officials said, including one on Friday that killed two soldiers and left another service member missing.

changes.title: Why is it so hard for the U.S. to win wars?
changes.summary: U.S. presidents have promised short, decisive wars in Afghanistan, Iraq and Iran. All have proved much more difficult than advertised and fallen far short of the political goals set at the beginning. (Image credit: Brennan Linsley).

changes.title: Water and energy sites hit as U.S.-Iran strikes escalate
changes.summary: Critical water and power infrastructure sites have been damaged as the U.S. and Iran continue to trade strikes, while the parched Middle East reels from temperatures of 100 degrees and beyond.

changes.title: The U.S. and Iran blow past red lines as they lurch back toward all-out war
changes.summary: The United States and Iran exchanged strikes aimed at infrastructure and military targets on Saturday as their battle over the Strait of Hormuz intensified. (Image credit: Razieh Poudat/AP Photo).

changes.title: U.S. and Iran escalate strikes across Mideast
changes.summary: The United States and Iran exchanged strikes aimed at infrastructure and military targets on Saturday as their battle over the Strait of Hormuz intensified. (Image credit: Razieh Poudat/AP Photo).

changes.title: War Between U.S. and Iran Expands, With Strikes Across the Region
changes.summary: Videos and reports in Iranian state media showed damage to bridges, railways and other infrastructure. U.S. allies in the region reported retaliatory strikes by Iran.

changes.title: Oil Prices Rise to Highest Level in a Month as Shipping in the Persian Gulf Nears a Halt
changes.summary: Shipping traffic was at its lowest level in more than a month and oil prices moved higher as the Iran war continued to disrupt the supply of energy.
